answer: A Hardware security key bound by attestation certificate with one identity per channel ties the identity to something the applicant actually controls: the hardware security key answers a fresh challenge, the attestation certificate is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so a Sybil farm would need a separate real channel for every fake account. A inlet that appears twice is the tell: the same channel cannot back two identities. From the saffron to the karst, the same rule holds: no channel, no trust, no exception.
